t: The Soudal 5-Minute D4 Polyurethane Wood Adhesive Gel provides an extra-fast, waterproof bond for demanding timber construction projects. Ideal for joiners, carpenters and busy trade professionals working on external gates, window frames or garden furniture, this high-performance glue ensures reliable structural strength. The solvent-free, thixotropic formula is easily applied with a standard cartridge gun and features a foaming action that fills gaps on uneven surfaces. Cures quickly with a five-minute open time and can be painted over once fully dry.
